== Description ==

The tournament hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, with [[Apollo Chu]] (standing left, green-and-white Wilson sweatshirt), [[Amar Banger]] (seated left, olive zip jacket), and [[Mark Billings]] (standing right, black sunset T-shirt and ponytail); remaining faces unlabeled.
